name: jev-decisions
description: Ask the hosted Jev API typed questions about a piece of text — yes/no, multiple choice, or a continuous rubric score — and get calibrated probabilities back, with the text split into 512-token chunks and the requests retried, batched eight questions at a time and run in parallel; scores publish to the shared experiments database as their own `jev_criterion` rows, stamped with the model.
